newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador inflation rises to 25.5 pct in 1996 - govt.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador inflation rises to 25.5 pct in 1996 - govt.

text.p: Ecuador's consumer price inflation was 25.53 percent in 1996, up from 22.8 percent the year before, the government's Institute of Statistics said Thursday.
Inflation finished the year slightly above the government's forecast of 25 percent.
In 1994, Ecuador had inflation of 25.4 percent.
The Institute said consumer prices rose 1.29 percent in the month of December, slowing from 2.22 percent in November.
